tagline: Tells you what an investor will actually understand and remember
description: Upload the deck and it reports back on what lands, what gets believed, what raises a question, and what survives the meeting, then helps you sharpen the story around that.

source.excerpt: Shared as a deck coach reporting what an investor takes away, not what you meant.

body:
## What it does

Upload the deck and it reports back on what lands, what gets believed, what raises a question, and what survives the meeting, then helps you sharpen the story around that. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @hnshah shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
